preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all('|' in part and ',' not in part for part in input_str.split(',') if part.strip())
preconditions.description: Each time segment must be in the format 'h|m|s' and separated by commas.

preconditions.expression: all(len(part.split('|')) == 3 for part in input_str.split(',') if part.strip())
preconditions.description: Each time segment must have exactly three components (h, m, s).

preconditions.expression: all(part.strip() != '' for part in input_str.split(',')) or input_str.strip() == ''
preconditions.description: Each time segment must be non-empty, or the input string is empty.

postconditions.description: If the input string is empty, the output must be an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(part) == 2 for part in output_str.split() if '|' in part)
postconditions.description: Each time component (hh, mm, ss) in the output must be exactly two digits.

postconditions.expression: output_str.startswith('Range:') and 'Average:' in output_str and 'Median:' in output_str
postconditions.description: The output string must contain exactly three statistics: Range, Average, and Median.

postconditions.expression: all('|' in part for part in output_str.split() if part.startswith(('Range:', 'Average:', 'Median:')) and part != 'Range:' and part != 'Average:' and part != 'Median:')
postconditions.description: Each statistic value must be in the format 'hh|mm|ss'.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(part.split('|')[0]) <= 23 and 0 <= int(part.split('|')[1]) <= 59 and 0 <= int(part.split('|')[2]) <= 59 for part in output_str.split() if '|' in part)
postconditions.description: Each time component (hh, mm, ss) in the output must represent a valid time (00:00:00 to 23:59:59).

postconditions.expression: all(len(part) == 2 for part in output_str.split() if '|' in part and part != 'Range:' and part != 'Average:' and part != 'Median:')
postconditions.description: Each time component (hh, mm, ss) in the output must be exactly two digits.
